what_i_changed: Fixed evidence-reader fallback so absent evidence is built from the supplied reader’s advertised names, preserving the category read failure. Added deterministic scoring and screening port protocols, wired execute() through both, and added a regression test proving supplied ports are called. Verified: 320 passed, 3 skipped.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: execute() now accepts and invokes ScoringPort and ScreeningPort implementations, with deterministic defaults. Thus scoring and screening ports are real runtime boundaries, not merely mentioned.
